description: This file contains shell script functions for setting boot device variables and performing upgrade and image validation tasks in an embedded Linux environment, likely related to OpenWRT or similar firmware.

methods.name: export_fitblk_bootdev
methods.description: Sets environment variables for boot device detection based on system device tree and filesystem nodes.

methods.name: fit_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade based on detected boot method, using appropriate command.

methods.name: fit_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image by checking its magic number and signature.
